caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Hendricks County Rural Electric Membership Corp.
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Hendricks County Rural Electric Membership Corp. National Labor Relations Board v. Malleable Iron Range Co. and Hendricks County Rural Electric Membership Corp. v. National Labor Relations Board

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Motion of Office & Professional Employees, AFL-CIO, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in No. 80-885 granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: No. 80-885 (first case) and No. 80-1103, 627 F. 2d 766; No. 80-885 (second case), 631 F. 2d 734.
